summary: The retention_plan example refuses --trim unless a passing checkpoint proof was produced in the same run for the exact cut and drop plan. Proof-only runs still report failed proofs without deleting data.

compatibility.detail: The retention_plan example now requires SCRATCH and a passing proof for --trim; missing, failed or mismatched proofs refuse deletion. The report format is unchanged.

manual.detail: Supply SCRATCH when using retention_plan --trim, and resolve any proof failure before trimming. Continue to use only a private copied store.

recovery.detail: No data migration; a refused trim leaves the drop set untouched.
